# IEEE
> IEEE is a professional association and publishing platform for engineering, computing, and technology research, standards, education, and membership.

IEEE.org provides access to scholarly publications, standards activities, conferences, educational resources, professional programs, and society information across technical disciplines.

## Publications and Research
- [IEEE Xplore Digital Library](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/): Search and access IEEE journals, conference proceedings, standards, and ebooks.
- [Journals & Magazines](https://www.ieee.org/publications/journals-magazines/index.html): Overview of IEEE periodicals across engineering, computing, and technology fields.
- [Conferences](https://www.ieee.org/conferences/index.html): Discover IEEE-sponsored conferences, events, and related publication opportunities.
- [Books](https://www.ieee.org/publications/books/index.html): Information about IEEE books and long-form technical publishing programs.
- [Authors](https://www.ieee.org/publications/authors/index.html): Resources for manuscript preparation, submission, publishing, and author tools.
- [Open Access](https://www.ieee.org/publications/open-access/index.html): Open access publishing options, journals, policies, and article processing information.
- [IEEE DataPort](https://ieee-dataport.org/): Dataset platform for sharing, accessing, and managing research data.

## Standards
- [IEEE Standards Association](https://standards.ieee.org/): Home for IEEE standards development, governance, and industry engagement.
- [Develop Standards](https://standards.ieee.org/develop/): Guidance for participating in and creating IEEE standards projects.
- [IEEE Standards Store](https://standards.ieee.org/standard/): Browse and obtain published IEEE standards and related documents.
- [Get Involved](https://standards.ieee.org/get-involved/): Learn how individuals and organizations can join standards activities.
- [Industry Connections](https://standards.ieee.org/industry-connections/): Programs that convene industry stakeholders around emerging technical topics.
- [Standards Education](https://standards.ieee.org/education/): Educational materials and programs about standards and standards development.

## Membership and Communities
- [IEEE Membership](https://www.ieee.org/membership/index.html): Membership benefits, eligibility, pricing, and joining information.
- [Membership Benefits](https://www.ieee.org/membership/benefits/index.html): Detailed overview of professional, technical, and career member benefits.
- [Technical Societies](https://www.ieee.org/communities/societies/index.html): Explore IEEE societies and technical communities by discipline.
- [Regions, Sections, and Chapters](https://www.ieee.org/communities/index.html): Geographic units and local communities for member engagement.
- [Young Professionals](https://www.ieee.org/membership/young-professionals/index.html): Programs and resources for early-career technology professionals.
- [Students](https://www.ieee.org/membership/students/index.html): Student membership information, benefits, and campus engagement resources.
- [Women in Engineering](https://www.ieee.org/membership/women/index.html): Community, events, and initiatives supporting women in engineering and technology.

## Education and Learning
- [IEEE Learning Network](https://iln.ieee.org/): Online courses, continuing education, and professional development offerings.
- [Educational Activities](https://www.ieee.org/education/index.html): IEEE education programs, accreditation support, and lifelong learning resources.
- [Continuing Education](https://www.ieee.org/education/continuing-education/index.html): Professional development and continuing education opportunities for practitioners.
- [Preuniversity Education](https://www.ieee.org/education/preuniversity/index.html): STEM outreach and educational resources for preuniversity audiences.
- [TryEngineering](https://tryengineering.org/): STEM lessons, activities, and career exploration for students and educators.
- [IEEE Certificates](https://www.ieee.org/education/certificates/index.html): Certificate programs and credential-oriented learning opportunities.

## Conferences and Events
- [IEEE Conferences](https://www.ieee.org/conferences/index.html): Central hub for IEEE conference participation, organization, and policies.
- [Conference Search](https://conferences.ieee.org/conferences_events/conferences/search?q=*): Search IEEE conferences by topic, date, and location.
- [Organize a Conference](https://www.ieee.org/conferences/organizers/index.html): Guidance for planning, sponsoring, and managing IEEE conferences.
- [Conference Publishing Services](https://www.computer.org/conferences/cps): Publishing support for conference proceedings through IEEE Computer Society.
- [Meetings, Conferences & Events](https://events.vtools.ieee.org/): Browse IEEE meetings and events across organizational units.

## Careers and Professional Development
- [IEEE Job Site](https://jobs.ieee.org/): Career listings and employment resources for engineers and technology professionals.
- [Career Resources](https://www.ieee.org/membership/career/index.html): Professional development tools, guidance, and career support resources.
- [Consultants Network](https://www.ieee.org/membership/consultants/index.html): Resources and community information for independent consultants.
- [Entrepreneurship](https://entrepreneurship.ieee.org/): Programs, stories, and resources for technology entrepreneurs and innovators.
- [Awards](https://www.ieee.org/about/awards/index.html): IEEE medals, technical field awards, and recognition programs.

## Governance and Organization
- [About IEEE](https://www.ieee.org/about/index.html): Overview of IEEE mission, history, leadership, and organizational structure.
- [Board of Directors](https://www.ieee.org/about/corporate/board-of-directors.html): Information about IEEE governance and current board leadership.
- [Corporate Governance](https://www.ieee.org/about/corporate/governance.html): Governance policies, organizational documents, and leadership structure.
- [Code of Ethics](https://www.ieee.org/about/corporate/governance/p7-8.html): IEEE code of ethics for members, volunteers, and professionals.
- [IEEE Foundation](https://www.ieeefoundation.org/): Philanthropic arm supporting IEEE programs, education, and humanitarian initiatives.
- [History Center](https://ethw.org/IEEE_History_Center): Historical resources on IEEE and the development of technology.

## News and Insights
- [The Institute](https://www.theinstitute.ieee.org/): News and analysis about technology, engineering, and the IEEE community.
- [IEEE Spectrum](https://spectrum.ieee.org/): Technology news, features, and analysis for engineers and researchers.
- [Press Releases](https://www.ieee.org/about/news/index.html): Official IEEE announcements, media resources, and organizational news.
- [Blogs](https://www.ieee.org/about/news/ieee-blog.html): IEEE blog content covering technology, policy, and professional topics.

## Support and Access
- [Contact IEEE](https://www.ieee.org/about/contact/index.html): Contact information for IEEE services, support, and organizational inquiries.
- [Help Center](https://supportcenter.ieee.org/): Support portal for accounts, subscriptions, publications, and member services.
- [IEEE Account](https://www.ieee.org/account/index.html): Account access and profile management for IEEE users and members.
- [Subscriptions](https://www.ieee.org/membership-catalog/subscriptions.html): Information on IEEE subscriptions, products, and purchase options.
- [Accessibility](https://www.ieee.org/accessibility_statement.html): Accessibility statement and information about accessible digital services.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.ieee.org/security-privacy.html): Privacy, security, and terms information for IEEE websites and services.
